FAQ.heading: Frequently Asked Questions
FAQ.desc: Go through the FAQ’s to know more about our Full Stack developer course, fees and project details.

FaqDATA.ques: What are the learning options for the course?
FaqDATA.ans: The programme runs as live, instructor-led online sessions rather than pre-recorded video - so you're learning in real time with an instructor you can ask questions. Alongside the live classes, there's a blended track for working professionals who need more flexibility, and a hands-on project component where you apply what you've learned on real industry-style work rather than isolated exercises.

FaqDATA.ques: What happens if I miss a live class?
FaqDATA.ans: Every live session is recorded, and you get unlimited access to those recordings - so missing a class doesn't mean losing the material. That said, we'd still recommend attending live where you can, since the real-time Q&A with the instructor is harder to replicate afterward.

FaqDATA.ques: What if I don't fully understand a module?
FaqDATA.ans: You can sit in on that same module again with a later batch at no extra cost. The goal is that you actually come away understanding the material, not just that you sat through it once.

FaqDATA.ques: Are there fee discounts or scholarships available?
FaqDATA.ans: Eligible candidates can get up to 10% off the course fee through our scholarship programme, which also extends to unemployed candidates and mothers returning to the workforce after a career break.

FaqDATA.ques: What certification do I get at the end?
FaqDATA.ans: You get a project-based certificate that reflects the real work you built during the course, not just attendance. If your industry project was completed in partnership with a hiring company, that company can also issue you direct certification for the work.
